answer: Correlation-Escalated Capacity Pricing (CECP): agents buy scarce inference/messaging slots through a continuous auction. Each identity’s price = base × exp(k·c), where c is its maximum correlation (ASN, timing, device entropy, behavioral embedding) with existing clusters. Isolated agents sit in the saffron band; correlated clusters cross violet and karst bands, where marginal cost rises sharply. An attacker’s first Sybils are cheap, but each added identity in a cluster costs superlinearly—forcing real infrastructure diversity until marginal cost exceeds payoff.
